name: SRP E-67 Standard Price Plan for Large Load Substation Large General Service
country_or_region: Salt River Project service territory, Arizona, United States
known_limitations: The tariff defines service and billing conditions for qualifying SRP large-load accounts. It does not identify a semiconductor customer, confirm that facilities of adequate capacity exist at a site, disclose an executed service agreement, or establish an interconnection date.
jurisdiction: Salt River Project service territory, Arizona
automation_notes: Review later E-67 revisions, Facilities Rider changes, large-load service agreements, and named customer records. Do not treat tariff eligibility as proof of site capacity.
notes: Phase 51B large-load service record. The plan is effective with the November 2025 billing cycle and applies to new accounts at or forecast to reach at least 20 MW within five years.
